desc:
⚽ FIRST PERSON SOCCER
Step onto the pitch and play from a true first-person perspective! You ARE the feet. Every touch, pass, shot and save is in your control.

🦶 Swing your foot with your mouse or thumb: real physics, no auto-kicks
🎯 Curl shots into the top corner, volley and pull off bicycle kicks
🧤 Switch to keeper gloves and dive for match-winning saves
⚔️ 4v4 Red vs Blue matches, with bots filling empty spots
🤖 1v1 cages vs friends or AI on Easy, Pro & World Class
🎬 Relive your goals in cinematic replays
🎉 Celebrate with emotes & collect 98 cleats, cards and goal effects
👥 Party up with friends and climb the weekly leaderboards
🎮 PC • Mobile • Controller

🎁 Use code KICKOFF for free Cash!

Control the ball. Find the top corner. Become a legend. 🏆
